parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of wood, typically rectangular and attached to the cabinet frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main access point to the cabinet interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: This is the drawer component made of wood, designed to slide in and out of the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides enclosed storage space for smaller items and is accessed by pulling it outward.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along rails or guides for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and support for the door, drawer, and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom base panel of the cabinet, made of solid wood or plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and provides stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is the internal shelf made of wood, positioned horizontally inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for organized storage of items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.
